_comment: Local conditions, issue #129 phase 2: events of the neighbourhood that last several days (not the one-day events of #31). Each changes the potential visitors and can pull categories; with the rivals the market factor stays within [floor, ceiling]. Fictional places only. Initial values, to be tuned by play.
